units: <cite ref="Shabbat 153b:10">Sabb. 153ᵇ</cite> <he>רָץ תחתיה וכ׳</he> he must run under it (with the burden on his shoulders) until he reaches his home, opp. <he>קלי קלי</he>.
Ber. 6ᵇ לעולם יָרוּץ אדם וכ׳ man should always run to hear the word of the hălakhah, even on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:20">Ab. V, 20</cite> <he>רץ כצבי</he> quick like a deer.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a:8">Snh. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>יכול אני לָרוּץ וכ׳</he> I can run for three parasangs in front of horses.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ומה בשכר … שרץ</he> thou wonderest at the reward for four steps which that wicked man (Baladan) ran for my honor’s sake; <he>שרָצוּ לפני וכ׳</he> who ran before me like horses; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make run, hasten. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 2 למה רַצְתָּ … מצרי הֱרִיצַנִי וכ׳ why didst thou run after my children?, and he (the horse) says, the Egyptian made me run against my will; הסוס הריצני וכ׳ the horse carried me swiftly against my will. Ib.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 2">B’shall., s. 2</cite> <he>שהיו מְרִיצִים המרכבה</he> who drove the chariot. Y. Shek. VIII, 51ᵃ bot. <he>מְרִיצִין</he>, v. <cite ref="M02677"><he>מְרִיצָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6:1">Koh. R. to XII, 6</cite> (play on <he>ותרץ</he>, <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6:1">ib.</cite>) <he>ומְרִיצָה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00885"><he>גָּלָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ומריקה</he> (corr. acc.).
Gen. R. s. 13 אר̇ץ̇ כנגד … שהיא מר̇יצ̇ה וכ׳ the earth is called erets, corresponding to the spring season, when she hastens her fruits to come forth.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> <he>דברים שהן מריצין לבני מעים</he> things which make the bowels run (loosen the bowels); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 344:2">Yalk. Ez. 344</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 18:1">Pesik. R. s. 18</cite> <he>מצירים</he> (corr. acc.); (Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 71 <he>משלשלום</he>); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>; Tanḥ. Balak 4 <he>הכל מריצים</he>, v. <cite ref="T01001"><he>רָצַץ</he></cite>.]
